sentences.text: NOTE 03. 22.12.2025 BVLNC,J I.A.No.02 of 2024 Heard Sri R.K.Acharyulu, learned counsel for the petitioner/appellant/convict and learned Additional Public Prosecutor representing the State.

Learned counsel for the  petitioner/convict would submit that the appellant was found guilty for the offence under Sections 376(2)(i) of IPC, 376(2)(f) of IPC and Sections 5(m) r/w 6 of POCSO Act, and Section 5(n) r/w 6 of POCSO Act and he was sentenced to undergo rigorous imprisonment for a period of ten (10) years and to pay a fine of Rs.1,000/-
(Rupees One Thousand only), in default, to suffer simple imprisonment for a period of six (06)
months for the offence under Section 5(m) r/w 6 of POCSO Act, 2012.

The petitioner/appellant was further sentenced to undergo rigorous imprisonment for a period of ten (10) years and to pay a fine of Rs.1,000/- (Rupees One Thousand only), in default, to suffer simple imprisonment for a Contd.,2 period of six (06) months for the offence under Section 5(n) r/w 6 of POCSO Act, 2012.
Both the sentences shall run concurrently.

Learned counsel for the petitioner/ appellant would submit that accused did not commit any offence and the petitioner/appellant filed appeal challenging the judgment of the learned Special Court and therefore, sentence may be suspended, pending disposal of the appeal.
Learned Additional Public Prosecutor vehemently opposed the application contending that it is a case of father sexually assaulted his daughter.
Considering the facts and circumstances of the offence, it is not a fit case for suspension of sentence.

Perusal of the record shows that the victim is daughter of the petitioner/appellant/convict and he was sentenced to suffer imprisonment for a period of ten (10) years for the offence under 5(m) r/w 6 of POCSO Act, and Section 5(n) r/w 6 of POCSO Act.
Considering the facts and circumstances of the case, nature of the offence, the manner in which it was committed, this Court is not inclined to suspend the order of sentence of imprisonment.
Contd.,3
Accordingly, the application is dismissed.
BVLNC,J Heard.
Admit.
Call for Trial Court record.
Registry is directed to prepare paper booklet, as soon as Trial Court record is received.
